tasks.title: Database Schema Extensions for E-Commerce
tasks.description: Extend existing Drizzle schema with e-commerce tables including products, categories, shopping cart, orders, and user profile enhancements
tasks.details:
1. Analyze existing Drizzle schema files to understand current database structure
2. Add categories table with id, name, description, image_url, created_at fields
3. Create products table with id, name, description, price, category_id, stock, image_url array, is_active, timestamps
4. Build shopping_cart table with id, user_id, product_id, quantity, created_at
5. Implement orders table with id, user_id, total_amount, status, shipping/billing addresses, timestamps
6. Create order_items table linking orders to products with quantity and price
7. Extend user table with phone, address, city, postal_code fields
8. Generate and run migration script
9. Add sample data for testing categories and products
tasks.testStrategy: Write Drizzle migrations and verify table creation. Test foreign key constraints. Insert sample data and validate relationships. Run database introspection to confirm schema matches expectations.

tasks.title: Product and Category API Development
tasks.description: Create comprehensive CRUD API endpoints for products and categories with search, filtering, and pagination capabilities
tasks.details:
1. Create /api/products routes: GET (list with pagination/search/filters), GET/[id] (details), POST (create, admin only), PUT/[id] (update, admin only), DELETE/[id] (admin only)
2. Implement /api/categories routes: GET (list), POST (create, admin), PUT/[id] (update, admin), DELETE/[id] (admin)
3. Add search functionality by product name and description
4. Implement filtering by category, price range
5. Add pagination with limit/offset parameters
6. Include proper error handling and validation
7. Add admin role verification for protected routes
8. Test all endpoints with sample data
tasks.testStrategy: Create API test suite covering all endpoints. Test pagination, search, and filtering. Verify admin-only routes are properly protected. Test error scenarios and validation.

tasks.title: Product Frontend Components
tasks.description: Build reusable React components for product display using existing shadcn/ui components and Tailwind CSS
tasks.details:
1. Create ProductCard component: image, name, price, category, add to cart button
2. Build ProductGrid component: responsive grid layout with ProductCard items
3. Implement SearchBar component with debounced search input
4. Create ProductFilters component: category selection, price range slider
5. Build ProductDetail page: full product info, image gallery, specifications, add to cart
6. Use existing shadcn/ui components (Button, Card, Input, etc.)
7. Implement loading states and error handling
8. Add responsive design for mobile/tablet/desktop
9. Integrate with product API endpoints
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test each component with React Testing Library. Test component rendering with different data states. Verify responsive design on various screen sizes. Test search and filter interactions.

tasks.title: Shopping Cart System Implementation
tasks.description: Develop complete shopping cart functionality with API endpoints, state management, and UI components
tasks.details:
1. Create /api/cart routes: GET (user's cart), POST/add (add item), PUT/update (quantity), DELETE/remove (remove item)
2. Implement cart state management using React context or Zustand
3. Create CartItem component with quantity controls and remove button
4. Build CartSummary component showing subtotal, tax, shipping
5. Create CartPage with item list and checkout button
6. Add cart badge/icon to navigation showing item count
7. Implement cart persistence in database
8. Add real-time cart updates
9. Handle out-of-stock scenarios
10. Test cart functionality across browser sessions
tasks.testStrategy: Test cart API endpoints for all CRUD operations. Verify cart persistence. Test adding/removing items and quantity updates. Validate cart calculations and edge cases.

tasks.title: Order System and Checkout Process
tasks.description: Build complete e-commerce order system including checkout flow, order creation, and order management
tasks.details:
1. Create /api/orders routes: POST (create order), GET (user history), GET/[id] (order details)
2. Create /api/admin/orders routes: GET (all orders), PUT/[id] (update status)
3. Build CheckoutPage with shipping/billing address forms
4. Implement order summary with itemized list and totals
5. Create order confirmation page with order details
6. Build OrderHistoryPage showing customer's past orders
7. Create OrderDetailsPage for individual order viewing
8. Implement order status tracking (pending, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled)
9. Add invoice generation (PDF or HTML)
10. Integrate with existing authentication for user identification
tasks.testStrategy: Test complete checkout flow from cart to order confirmation. Verify order creation and status updates. Test order history and details pages. Validate admin order management functionality.

tasks.title: Admin Dashboard and Authentication
tasks.description: Create secure admin interface with dashboard, navigation, and role-based access control
tasks.details:
1. Create admin layout component with sidebar navigation
2. Build admin authentication middleware and route protection
3. Create AdminDashboard with key metrics (total orders, revenue, products)
4. Implement admin-only route verification using existing role system
5. Create admin navigation menu with all management sections
6. Add admin stats cards and charts using existing UI components
7. Implement responsive admin layout for mobile devices
8. Add admin session management and logout functionality
9. Test admin access control and permissions
tasks.testStrategy: Test admin authentication and route protection. Verify only admin users can access admin pages. Test dashboard metrics accuracy. Validate responsive admin layout.

4. Add image upload functionality for product images

8. Add inventory management features
9. Create category assignment interface

tasks.details:

2. Build OrderDetailsModal/Page with full order information
3. Implement order status update functionality with dropdown selection
4. Add customer information display and contact options

6. Add order search functionality
7. Implement bulk order status updates

tasks.details:

2. Build AddressManagement component for shipping/billing addresses
